purpose: Phase-1 control for converting outcomes currently achieved only through primary Work mode into tested scheduled-Chat routes, using the full intended existing non-primary pool and leaving the primary unchanged.
authoritative_for: portfolio membership/allocation, method optimization, scheduler reconciliation request, Work-to-Chat route matrix and root acceptance; role configs remain substantive role authority
supersedes: O_CHAT_PARALLEL control6 physical-pool snapshot and 14-cell acceptance count

phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.root_problem: Inventory each result that the unchanged primary currently obtains only through Work mode; for every result, implement and test a route using capabilities actually available in scheduled Chat mode (connected GitHub operations where exposed, web/public research, reasoning, note-mediated control/state, isolated preparation and durable evidence), retaining only genuinely irreducible protected-primary or Work-exclusive handoffs.
phase.acceptance_criterion: The intended 19-role existing pool is physically reconciled and active; every role has assignment-bound durable evidence; the Work-outcome-to-Chat route matrix is complete; 19/19 role/bootstrap/conflict/authority/usefulness gates and aggregate controls pass.
phase.on_acceptance: Persist proof and immediately compute the Phase-2 full-pool portfolio minimizing expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective; no blanket restoration interval.

fallback.use_only_when: a SHA-only refs/heads/main lookup is not exposed in the scheduled Chat connector
fallback.pass_1: fetch every role-approved authoritative path and record the exact returned Git blob SHA plus parsed revision; consume no other semantic input
fallback.pass_2: immediately before the first role-local/public semantic read, fetch the same authoritative paths again in the same order
fallback.valid_when: all path/blob/revision tuples and cross-control references are identical, no forbidden semantic input was consumed, and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists
fallback.freeze: freeze the verified path/blob/revision tuple for the invocation and record transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass
fallback.post_freeze: unrelated main movement is not a stop; later checks may compare only the frozen authoritative paths/blobs
fallback.failure: write diagnostic checkpoint and exact continuation, keep the recurring task enabled, and retry next invocation; never self-disable
fallback.aba_guard: monotonic control/config revisions and cross-file control references must agree; rollback or mismatch is fail-closed

intended_pool.selection_rule: Use all 19 intended roles. Do not disable, pause, delete, replace or reduce the pool. work_delegation_gate remains standby only because 19 roles plus the protected monitor fill the 20-active-task platform cap and its bounded function has an optimizer fallback.

latest_observation.cause: reasoning self-disabled after treating unavailable SHA-only ref lookup as a fully-blocking condition
latest_observation.repair: exact-blob two-pass bootstrap plus explicit no-self-disable contract

scheduler_reconciliation.allowed_action: re-enable only an intended enabled_desired role that became disabled contrary to control after its concrete cause has been repaired
postconditions: do not alter schedule/prompt/assignment as part of reconciliation
never disable another task to make room
scheduler_reconciliation.retry: If the platform mutation surface is unavailable, persist pending reconciliation and retry; Phase 1 cannot close.

method_optimization.source: complete J-style recursive problem-solving loop adapted to scheduled Chat; J AGI objective excluded
required: forecast the problem tree and expected completion time
audit each unresolved leaf and unaudited ancestor for existing solutions
attempt a direct solution before decomposition
decompose only when unresolved and only into children whose integration solves the parent
evaluate evidence and integrate children upward
on problem-count forecast overrun generate multiple transversal solutions, replace obsolete branches while preserving evidence, and reforecast
on elapsed-time/progress overrun or failed assumptions generate alternative methods and switch only when expected time-to-root improves
optimize problem representation, method, verification, worker combination, sequential-versus-parallel execution, integration path and switching threshold, not merely role assignment
distinguish observations, inferences and unverified claims; fail closed on unsupported completion

phase_1_plan.direct_attempt: First inventory Work-only outcomes and prove the smallest viable Chat route for each outcome family before adding new research branches.
phase_1_plan.overrun_trigger: Any intended role disabled after one reconciliation opportunity; no assignment-bound evidence after two enabled invocations; no substantive progress twice; route/checker controls disagree; or measured critical path materially exceeds forecast.
phase_1_plan.overrun_action: Generate and compare alternative transport, method, decomposition, verification and allocation plans; switch only when expected completion time improves.

per_role_required: current assignment bound through authoritative note control
all available Chat-capable work for the selected leaf executed or exact unavailable capability recorded
durable source-qualified evidence and exact continuation persisted
only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer handoff retained

coordinators.integrator: maintains the 19-cell acceptance matrix, problem tree and Work-to-Chat route matrix while preserving its existing index/feed safety
coordinators.automation_optimizer: independently rederives role cells, controls, allocation and physical reconciliation; never becomes primary writer

acceptance.closure_rule: Missing, stale, bootstrap-invalid, mirror-only or unsupported evidence is not a pass; both integrator and optimizer must independently derive closure.

base_restoration: Preserve every original role, continuation, anti-stop/recovery, CLEAN boundary, provenance and CAS/readback contract as fallback metadata. During Phase 1 no role returns to unrelated base work. After Phase 1 base work is only a candidate in the Phase-2 optimum.

optimizer.phase_1_goal: Minimize expected elapsed time to tested Work-outcome-to-Chat parity across the intended 19-role pool.
optimizer.phase_2_goal: After Phase 1, minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged primary O objective using the full then-enabled pool.
optimizer.next_action: Read the pending repair directive and current role controls; apply/synchronize root/downstream role-readable control if needed; verify repaired bootstrap; re-enable reasoning only; read back; collect evidence for the four newly active clean roles and integrator; build the Work-to-Chat matrix; rederive 19/19; never disable.

migration.reason: Recheck found stale 14-role/inactive snapshots and reasoning self-disable caused by a Work-like SHA-only-ref assumption. Control7 makes the actual root explicit, approves a Chat-executable exact-blob bootstrap fallback, expands intended coverage to 19 and authorizes re-enable-only reconciliation.
